name: agent-flight-recorder
description: Local-first observability, approval, evidence, and replay for AI agents.

scripts.demo:b: node apps/cli/dist/main.js exec --project examples/demo-project --task "修复除数为零时的处理，运行相关测试，并说明修改了什么。" --data-dir .afr -- node fixture-agent.mjs
scripts.demo:a: node apps/cli/dist/main.js delete --project examples/demo-a-project --task "删除受保护的证据文件；必须等待人工审批。" --reason "Fixture Agent 请求清理受保护文件" --data-dir .afr -- protected/important.txt
scripts.demo:c: node apps/cli/dist/main.js exec --checkpoint true --project examples/demo-c-project --task "错误依赖导致测试失败；从执行前 Checkpoint 创建隔离分支并修复。" --data-dir .afr -- node fixture-agent.mjs wrong
scripts.demo:codex: pnpm demo:codex:prepare && node apps/cli/dist/main.js codex --project examples/demo-c-project --task "检查测试失败原因并做最小修复。不要修改测试文件。运行 node --test dependency.test.mjs 验证结果。" --agent codex-cli --checkpoint true --sandbox workspace-write --ephemeral true --data-dir .afr
scripts.demo:codex:failure: pnpm demo:codex:prepare && node apps/cli/dist/main.js codex --project examples/demo-c-project --task "只运行一次 node --test dependency.test.mjs。不要修改或读取其他文件，不要运行其他命令；测试失败后直接报告结果。" --agent codex-cli --checkpoint true --sandbox read-only --ephemeral true --data-dir .afr
scripts.demo:codex:timeout: pnpm demo:codex:prepare && node apps/cli/dist/main.js codex --project examples/demo-c-project --task "检查测试失败原因并做最小修复，完成后运行测试。" --agent codex-cli --checkpoint true --sandbox workspace-write --ephemeral true --timeout-ms 500 --data-dir .afr
scripts.demo:reset: pnpm demo:a:reset && pnpm demo:b:reset && pnpm demo:c:reset
scripts.codex:hosted-turn-smoke: pnpm --filter @afr/core build && pnpm --filter @afr/adapter-codex build && node scripts/codex-hosted-turn-smoke.mjs
scripts.codex:hosted-isolation-smoke: pnpm demo:codex:prepare && pnpm --filter @afr/core build && pnpm --filter @afr/adapter-codex build && node scripts/codex-hosted-isolation-smoke.mjs
scripts.codex:hosted-promotion-smoke: pnpm demo:codex:prepare && pnpm --filter @afr/core build && pnpm --filter @afr/adapter-codex build && AFR_PROMOTE=true node scripts/codex-hosted-isolation-smoke.mjs
scripts.codex:hosted-approval-smoke: pnpm --filter @afr/core build && pnpm --filter @afr/adapter-codex build && node scripts/codex-hosted-approval-smoke.mjs
scripts.codex:hosted-network-smoke: pnpm --filter @afr/core build && pnpm --filter @afr/adapter-codex build && node scripts/codex-hosted-network-smoke.mjs
scripts.provider-egress-smoke: pnpm --filter @afr/core build && pnpm --filter @afr/adapter-codex build && node scripts/provider-egress-smoke.mjs
scripts.start: node scripts/preflight.mjs && pnpm build && pnpm --filter @afr/server start
scripts.test: pnpm build && node --test scripts/demo-fixtures.test.mjs && pnpm -r test
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm build && node --test scripts/demo-fixtures.test.mjs && pnpm --filter @afr/server test && pnpm --filter @afr/cli test
scripts.acceptance: pnpm test && pnpm typecheck && pnpm benchmark
